note: The board id is the basename of data/results/<id>.csv (data/README.md, 'Board ids'). This file holds the only exceptions: short ids and page ids that older data files and the renderers still use, each mapped to the real id, and boards that have no results file yet. tools/board_ids.py --check fails on any other id.

alias_reasons.g3507, l1306, c1104, g3519, g5187: short ids in site/data/projects.json cells; tools/render_projects.py RESULT_BOARD and the id helper map them to the long ids
alias_reasons.tda4vm: id in site/data/ports.json; tools/render_ports.py FOLDER_ID maps it
alias_reasons.cc3551e, iwrl6432aop: board page ids (site/board-cc3551e.html, site/board-iwrl6432aop.html) that site/data/code.json is keyed by; tools/render_ports.py FOLDER_ID maps them
alias_reasons.am62l: short id used by the Doom and hub data in site/data/projects.json for the TMDS62LEVM (results file am62l-evm.csv)
